dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,65)>That Pokémon was always hiding in the sand—oh, and I
might’ve seen them sleeping in the grass, too!

<$voicel(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,839)><$comeff(2,21)>Oooh, you met <$cdef(27)><$cname(573)>? YAY! If they need anything,
make sure to help ’em out!

<$voicel(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,827)><$comeff(2,14)><$cdef(27)><$cname(573)> really loves cool-looking buildings.
<$voicel(2,8)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,654)><$comeff(2,10)>Maybe you could help ’em out if they’re itching to
<$cdef(27)><$spwfull(1)> something!
